name: Playa del Carmen
tagline: Caribbean Beach Life on a FIRE Budget
description: Playa del Carmen offers the rare combination of turquoise Caribbean waters, walkable town center, and a massive international expat community that makes the transition seamless. While pricier than inland Mexico, it remains a fraction of comparable beach destinations in the US or Europe, making it ideal for FIRE retirees who refuse to compromise on beach access.

quickFacts.visa: Temporary Resident Visa (1-4 years, renewable; requires proof of income ~$2,500/mo or savings ~$42,000)
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate — generally safe in tourist zones and residential areas; exercise standard caution
quickFacts.climate: Tropical — hot and humid with a rainy season June-November, hurricane risk

housing.description: Basic furnished studio or small 1BR in a budget inland colonia (Ejidal, Luis Donaldo Colosio), away from the beach and 5th Avenue; a sticky expat floor slightly above rock-bottom

dining.description: Taquerías, local fondas, and the mercado; mostly cooking at home

healthcare.description: Basic Mexico-only private major-medical (GNP/AXA/MetLife gastos médicos mayores) or IMSS voluntary; 45–55 early-retiree basis

transportation.description: Bicycle plus colectivos and the ADO bus, with an occasional taxi; no car

entertainment.description: Free public beaches, cenote day trips, 5th Avenue people-watching, cheap cantinas

1M.lifestyle: A budget furnished studio in an inland colonia like Ejidal or Colosio, away from the beach and 5th Avenue but a short ride from both. Most meals are cooked at home with taquería plates as the treat, and a bicycle plus colectivos and the ADO bus cover getting around; no car. The free Caribbean beaches, cenote day trips, and 5th Avenue people-watching do the entertaining. Utilities run higher than highland Mexico because of the AC load, and basic Mexican major-medical covers routine care with Cancún 45 minutes away for anything serious. A sticky but livable frugal floor in a genuine beach town.

housing.description: Furnished 1BR in a decent building in Centro or Gonzalo Guerrero, walkable to 5th Avenue

dining.description: Out several times a week across local eateries and 5th Avenue spots

healthcare.description: Comprehensive Mexico-only private with Hospiten Riviera Maya and Cancún specialist access

transportation.description: Scooter plus taxis and the ADO bus; occasional car rental for ruins/cenote trips

entertainment.description: Beach clubs, diving/snorkeling, weekend Tulum and Cozumel trips

2M.lifestyle: A furnished apartment in Centro or Gonzalo Guerrero, walkable to 5th Avenue and a few blocks from the sand. Dining out several nights a week across local eateries and Quinta Avenida spots is easy, comprehensive Mexican private cover reaches the Hospiten network with Cancún specialists in range, and a scooter handles errands. Beach clubs, regular diving and snorkeling, and quick weekend runs to Tulum or the Cozumel ferry fill the calendar in a relaxed coastal style.

housing.description: Quality furnished condo with pool and amenities near 5th Avenue or in Playacar Phase 2, walkable to the beach

dining.description: Frequent dining across Playa's better restaurants and beach clubs

healthcare.description: Comprehensive Mexico-only private at a higher hospital tier / lower deductible

transportation.description: An owned or leased car with insurance and fuel

entertainment.description: Premium beach-club access, diving, kitesurfing, catamaran and cenote trips

3M.lifestyle: A quality amenity condo with a pool near 5th Avenue or in Playacar Phase 2, walkable to the beach. Dining out is frequent across Playa's better restaurants and beach clubs, an owned car opens up the whole Riviera Maya, and a higher-tier Mexican private plan reaches the region's best hospitals. Premium beach-club access, kitesurfing, catamaran trips, and cenote weekends are standing habits — an unhurried coastal FIRE routine with genuine margin left over each month.

housing.description: Luxury condo or small villa in Playacar (Phase 1/2) or a gated beachfront complex, with pool and near-beach access

dining.description: Near-daily quality dining across the best restaurants and beach clubs

transportation.description: Leased/owned SUV plus private transfers and occasional charter

entertainment.description: VIP beach clubs, yacht day-charters, deep-sea fishing, golf at Grand Coral / El Camaleón, Tulum club scene

domesticHelp.description: Part-time housekeeper a few days a week

luxuryExtras.description: Charters, spa and wellness, club memberships, travel

5M.lifestyle: A luxury condo or small villa in Playacar with a pool and near-beach access, kept by a part-time housekeeper. Dining is near-daily across the best rooms and beach clubs, an entry-level international plan adds coverage beyond Mexico, and an SUV plus private transfers handle the coast. Yacht day-charters, deep-sea fishing, and golf at El Camaleón or Grand Coral define the leisure. This comfortably clears what day-to-day Playa absorbs, with the surplus flowing into charters, wellness, and travel.

housing.description: Luxury condo or a gated villa in Playacar or the Mayakoba area, with private pool and beach access

dining.description: Near-daily fine dining across 5th Avenue's and Mayakoba's best, plus private-chef occasions

healthcare.description: International concierge cover, worldwide including the US, with medevac to Houston/Miami

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle plus a boat and private transfers/charters (Cancún airport 45 min away)

entertainment.description: Yacht charters, sportfishing, golf at Mayakoba/El Camaleón, private cultural and cenote tours

luxuryExtras.description: Yacht mooring, resort/golf memberships, first-class travel, philanthropy

10M.lifestyle: A luxury condo or a gated villa in Playacar or the Mayakoba area — private pool, beach access — kept by a housekeeper-cook with part-time grounds help. Fine dining is near-daily across the Riviera Maya's best, a boat joins the luxury vehicle, and yacht charters, sportfishing, and championship golf are on tap. Concierge international cover with worldwide access and medevac to Houston or Miami closes the one real gap — distance from major hospitals. Unlike a small island, Playa's deep Mayakoba and Playacar luxury infrastructure absorbs this budget locally, with little need to spend off-area. The Caribbean coast at its most lavish.
